────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Intent

Complete all 8 official Entire at Neathacks 2026 hackathon ideas (#01-#08), add a POST /api/entire-onboarding-qa endpoint, and achieve a passing 16/16 pytest test suite.

## Outcome

All 8 ideas were implemented (#01 Agent Mistake Debugger, #02 Intent Reviewer, #03 Before You Build Assistant, #04 Architecture Drift Detector, #05 Interactive Onboarding Guide Q&A, #06 Regression Test Scout, #07 Checkpoint-to-Demo Generator, #08 External Agent Protocol v1 Adapter), the onboarding Q&A endpoint was added, and 16/16 pytest tests pass.

## Learnings

### Repository

- All 8 Neathacks 2026 Entire ideas are consolidated into a single module: src/verifix/entire_intelligence.py
- API routes for Entire features are registered in src/verifix/server.py
- The test suite for Entire features lives in benchmarks/test_suite.py and targets 16 test cases
- Documentation is maintained in docs/index.html alongside code changes

### Code

- `src/verifix/entire_intelligence.py` — Central module implementing all 8 Entire at Neathacks 2026 ideas including Architecture Drift Detector (#04), Interactive Onboarding Guide Q&A (#05), and External Agent Protocol v1 Adapter (#08)
- `src/verifix/server.py` — POST /api/entire-onboarding-qa endpoint was added here to expose the Idea #05 Interactive Onboarding Guide Q&A functionality
- `benchmarks/test_suite.py` — 16 pytest tests covering all 8 Entire ideas; suite must pass at 16/16 to satisfy acceptance criteria

### Workflow

- Hackathon-style delivery required implementing 8 distinct features in a single session with immediate test validation
- Docs (index.html) were updated in the same commit sweep as the implementation, keeping documentation in sync

## Open Items

- External Agent Protocol v1 Adapter (#08) may need versioning strategy as the protocol evolves beyond v1
- Architecture Drift Detector (#04) likely requires baseline architecture snapshots to be seeded per project before it is useful in production
- Interactive Onboarding Guide Q&A (#05) / POST /api/entire-onboarding-qa may need authentication and rate-limiting before public exposure
- 16 tests cover the happy path for all 8 ideas; edge-case and adversarial test coverage is not yet addressed

## Files

- `benchmarks/test_suite.py`
- `docs/index.html`
- `src/verifix/entire_intelligence.py`
- `src/verifix/server.py`
